body:
New cmd/git-log-indexer: walks a repo's HEAD history, ingests each commit via the existing POST /services/collector HEC endpoint (sourcetype=git_commit), immediately searchable via the existing search/portal UI. Idempotent per-repo cursor file. Caught and fixed a real bug in its own test suite (failure path advanced cursor past the failed commit). 5 new tests, go build/vet/test ./... clean. Live smoke-verified end to end against the real LogsHandler/FileEventLog code path with a real git repo. Found, not fixed: live production IDUNA has no IDUNA_HEC_TOKEN configured, so ingest is disabled there until an operator sets it. Commit f648c30.

⚓ ☃
title: IUS-001: git commit indexing for unified search shipped
